Hình ảnh bao quát về KCN Nội Bài.en: The Covering Picture of the Cabinet

KCN Nội Bài thu hút được các nhà đầu tư.en: The Cabinet was attracted to major investors also thanks to a partial, complete, comfortable infrastructure. With modern internal traffic, the line divides into 2 – 4 lanes of 35 – 40 m wide. Power is provided from the National Power grid at 110kV. And the clean water system works at a capacity of 3,500 m3 per night. Along with it is the firework system, the disposal of waste, telecommunications, all built by the Interior Investor.
KCN Nội Bài thu hút được các nhà đầu tư.zh: 内阁也由于部分、完整和舒适的基础设施而受到主要投资者的吸引。 随着现代内部交通,线路分出2~4道35~40米宽. 电力由110kV的国家电网提供. 而清水系统则以每晚3500立方米的容量运作. 连同烟花系统,垃圾处理,电信,全部由内地投资者所建.

Khu công nghiệp Nội Bài có vị trí vô cùn.en: The cabinet industry has an extremely favorable position, about 30 km from the center of Hanoi. Just near the Imperial Airport, only about 5 kilometres (5 km) and the distance to the stations were also convenient. The front of the cabinet industry has the province of 131 that runs via Highway 3 with Highway 2. In addition, it was easy to travel to the Long - Cabinet Highway, the same route to the Port of the Bridge and the Port of the Midland.
Khu công nghiệp Nội Bài có vị trí vô cùn.zh: 内阁工业地位极其有利,距离河内市中心约30公里. 就在帝国机场附近,只有约5公里(5公里)距离和车站的距离也是方便的. 内阁工业的前沿有131个行省,通过3号高速公路与2号高速公路相通. 此外还方便出行至长-内阁高速公路,同通大桥口和中地口.

Khu công nghiệp Nội Bài nằm giữa địa bàn.en: The Imperial Industrial Zone is located between the area of the Morning and Mai Ting, in the district of Mui Shan, Hanoi. The area of KNC is 114 (ha), with a full rate of 100%. Currently, in the Cabinet KNN article has offices of 39 investors, which come from many countries such as Korea, Japan, Malaysia,... And large businesses in Vietnam as the Vietnam THH Kishiro Company Vietnam, the IHIIKI CAST Vietnam, the NHH Fukoku Company Vietnam,...
Khu công nghiệp Nội Bài nằm giữa địa bàn.zh: 帝地工业区位于河内市密山区"晨报"和"梅亭"一带. 克伦尼共的面积为114(ha)个,全速率为100%. 目前,在内阁KNN文章中,有39个投资者的办公室,来自韩国,日本,马来西亚等许多国家. 在越南的大型企业有越南THH Kishiro公司、越南IHIIKI CAST、越南NHH Fukuku公司、......
